alex_w: quick Q — new /v1/inference/select endpoint: is routing_hint documented as a single string? My client needs to pass multiple hints (region + perf tier). Example payload I'm proposing:
```
{
  "model_id": "redwood/llama-13b-v2",
  "routing_hint": ["us-west-2", "low_latency"]
}
```
Will that be accepted or do we need "routing_hints": [..]? Also how does fallback order work if hints conflict?

maria_p: short answer — spec currently lists routing_hint as string|null. We debated pluralizing, but to avoid breakage runtime accepts both for now: prefer routing_hints (array) if present, otherwise fall back to routing_hint parsing. I'll update docs if we agree on semantics.

jordan_k: confirm runtime behavior: if routing_hints (array) provided -> use that order. else if routing_hint (string) -> try to parse comma-separated values then use that. fallback order is: exact route (model+region+tier) -> tier-only -> region-only -> global fallback. Pseudocode: 
```
// simplified
hints = routing_hints || parse_csv(routing_hint)
route = match_exact(hints) || match_tier(hints) || match_region(hints) || global_route
```

samir_g: small compatibility notes: when both fields present, routing_hints takes precedence. Dedicated customers who pin model_version bypass routing. Also console and trace events will show which hint matched.

contract-bot: api contract linter: PR #3221 — WARNING: docs need update for new routing_hints support. See https://git/repo/pull/3221 :warning:

alex_w: got it, i'll change the client to send routing_hints array and also keep a fallback that parses single-string routing_hint for older clients. Ping @maria_p for docs review — can you add examples for both formats and clarify fallback ordering? Also pinging @jordan_k for a small runtime unit test. PR link with client change: https://git/repo/pull/3300

maria_p: on it. I'll add examples for both singular + plural in api-changelog and a short note about fallback precedence. Assigning runtime verification to @jordan_k.

jordan_k: I'll add unit tests for: comma-separated parse (handle spaces), precedence when both fields present, and behavior when a hint references an unknown model/tag (should skip and continue matching). Also will add an integration check to ensure traces include hints_resolved.

samir_g: FYI: console will surface a new hints_resolved field in routing debug traces for 7 days, and we've enabled sampling for requests that exercise fallback logic. If you need extended retention, ping infra.

alex_w: thanks all :thumbsup: changing client now and will await the PRs. Marking this thread resolved from my side.
